subject.title: [Feature Request] Add tool call visibility to streamTo="parent" for ACP runtime

question: Should ACP `streamTo="parent"` expose child tool calls, tool results, and thinking-like internals to the parent session, and what redaction/default-visibility policy should govern that exposure?
rationale: The requested data can include secrets, local paths, command output, tool payloads, and reasoning-like content, so automation should not choose the visibility boundary without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define Redacted Projection
options.body: Expose bounded tool/progress summaries through existing ACP tag visibility and channel progress policy, with raw args/results/thought hidden by default and covered by tests/docs.

options.title: Keep Current Scope
options.body: Leave parent streams limited to assistant/commentary/status/lifecycle progress and direct detailed inspection to logs or richer session surfaces.

options.title: Add Explicit Full Relay
options.body: Allow raw tool and thought visibility only behind an explicit opt-in, accepting a larger security and privacy review burden.

recommendation.title: Define Redacted Projection
recommendation.body: Expose bounded tool/progress summaries through existing ACP tag visibility and channel progress policy, with raw args/results/thought hidden by default and covered by tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hardening work on the same ACP relay and projection settings makes this the best available routing candidate for the visibility and security choice.
